description: Curiosity-selected, receipt-gated challenge-point progression for whole-body balance and coordination.

rules.name: hcc_restore_shape_indexed_challenge_frontier
rules.comment: Warm-start the challenge frontier only from a memory attached to the graph-recognized body shape. Previously unsafe levels return contracted and eligible for new evidence.

rules.name: hcc_initialize_verified_takeoff_schema_refinement
rules.comment: When a complete takeoff schema first becomes reusable, discard pre-schema phase-compression counts. Those trials acquired the movement and are not evidence about how much of a verified movement can be pruned.

rules.name: hcc_initialize_challenge_uncertainty_from_body
rules.comment: Ground initial unresolved structure in the body's support-derived evidence window instead of a host-authored sample count or a fixed curriculum threshold.

rules.name: hcc_unlock_ballistic_landing_from_mastered_prior
rules.comment: Unlock a ballistic challenge only after its graph-held prerequisite has recovered safely once per sensed support. Transfer the measured safe impulse rather than restarting from an authored jump magnitude.

rules.name: hcc_curiosity_requests_challenge_point
rules.comment: At a body-derived recovery interval, decision_core ranks the still-safe challenge frontier. The graph specifies a normalized environmental impulse; the host only converts body weights to force.

rules.name: hcc_bind_issued_takeoff_trial_context
rules.comment: A self-generated challenge selected in the motor-decision tick adopts that same request's trial as its preparation action. This preserves causal task identity without host-side re-selection.

rules.name: hcc_bind_issued_takeoff_program_context
rules.comment: Carry the newly adopted task identity onto the exact population program enacted by the preparation trial.

rules.name: hcc_learn_challenge_envelope_from_receipt
rules.comment: Update competence, learning progress and the authorized challenge observation only from the exact action-time receipt. Promotion waits for delayed recovery evidence.

rules.name: hcc_observe_ballistic_flight_and_touchdown
rules.comment: A landing receipt is a temporal topology: zero support must be observed before restored support. Self-generated takeoff additionally requires positive whole-body vertical momentum, so a falling gait interval cannot masquerade as launch.

rules.name: hcc_close_expired_self_takeoff_actuation_window
rules.comment: A failed ballistic synthesis remains evidence for the open curriculum challenge, but it does not retain actuator authority through the subsequent recovery. Close the deliberate vertical residual after its graph-held evidence window; ordinary balance can then recover while the graph decides whether the attempt was underpowered or unsafe. No host timeout or fixed action count is introduced.

rules.name: hcc_accumulate_self_takeoff_ballistic_envelope
rules.comment: After positive-momentum support loss, accumulate one receipt per new sensor state and retain peak ballistic height. The state-sequence guard prevents fixpoint iterations from inventing flight duration.

rules.name: hcc_verify_recovered_jump_schema
rules.comment: Make phase transitions reusable only after the complete takeoff, aerial interval, touchdown, and locomotor recovery succeeds. Compression probes remain analysis-by-synthesis refinements inside those phases rather than blindly replaying the old trajectory.

rules.name: hcc_promote_challenge_after_delayed_recovery
rules.comment: Promote a challenge only after the body remains upright, exits recovery, regains its pre-challenge directed progress and completes another support cycle. Safe means task recovery, not merely postural survival.

rules.name: hcc_expand_ballistic_task_after_grounded_recovery
rules.comment: A stable trial which never leaves support is below the task threshold, not beyond the safety frontier. Preserve its eligibility and expand the stimulus by the graph-held evidence fraction; only an actual loss of recovery is unsafe.

rules.name: hcc_retain_unrecovered_challenge_as_boundary
rules.comment: A fall or failure to regain both posture and locomotion inside a support-topology-derived task window is an unsafe frontier observation, not success.

rules.name: hcc_mint_shape_indexed_challenge_memory
rules.comment: At an explicit lifetime boundary, mint observed challenge competence under the graph-recognized body shape.

rules.name: hcc_update_shape_indexed_challenge_memory
rules.comment: Refresh an existing shape-indexed frontier only at a later explicit lifetime boundary.
